summary: A dispatched worker lane has no Concord tool access; its packet is complete Concord context under generated denial and the adapter parent boundary. Oracle-bound lanes receive the same immutable job oracle, canonical ranked findings, and prior receipt references through the shared work-context reader. Current blockers cannot disappear through context selection. Lanes read pinned sources, inspect owners, and execute declared controls within permissions; independent review can report uncovered cases. Earlier receipts are baselines, not current-subject acceptance, and missing context uses the report boundary rather than Concord calls.
title: Worker lanes hold no Concord tool access, and the dispatch packet is their complete Concord context
